candidates.change_summary: Delete the balance update statement so deposits no longer increase the caller's balance.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so Put no longer records a log entry observable via Log.History.
Replace the clamped unlockTime assignment with a direct assignment of _unlockTime, allowing past timestamps to shorten the lock.
Delete the unlockTime assignment so Put no longer updates the caller's unlock time.
Delete the overflow-guard require so deposits behave even in edge cases where the guard would revert.
